source_units.text: Give a naming rationale for an invented plant cultivar.
The total word count must fall from 50 to 80, inclusive.
Use this fictional material: Propose Copper Lantern as the cultivar name.
Its invented traits are bronze petals and an evening bloom that opens after the surrounding flowers close.
Required wording, verbatim: "Copper Lantern", "bronze petals", "evening bloom".
The audience is a fictional nursery naming committee.
